openings.claim: A guided short-stroke sliding mass might seat through repeated axial impulses; a stop referencing an unvarnished surface would protect the face.
openings.discriminator: Predicts less lateral drift than flexure-striker under identical alignment errors; superiority unknown. A varnish strike or failure to seat defeats it.
openings.probe: Proposed only: compare drift and seating on sacrificial geometries with deliberate alignment offsets; inspect all contact marks.
openings.uncertainty: Stop positioning and sufficient impulse within 35 mm remain untested.

openings.discriminator: Predicts adequate seating where short-slide stalls, with worse aim expected. Failure to seat or visible-face contact defeats this prediction.
openings.probe: Proposed only: establish whether the indispensable sleeve can be made, then compare seating and aim on a surrogate.
openings.uncertainty: Sleeve availability and flexure fatigue unknown; no hard-constraint relaxation requested.
